## Highlights

- Added a local **Statistics** page: a hero "playlists generated" figure, a monthly activity chart, and ranked top-5 lists for artists, genres, moods and periods, each opening a full-detail page. A separate, de-emphasized **Nerd stats** page covers AI provider usage, generation timing and error breakdowns.
- **Diagnostics** is now its own page (previously a Settings section), and **Settings** itself is a normal page you navigate to instead of a popup overlay — both now match the rest of the app.
- Added an opt-in, fully anonymous "playlist generated" ping to a public aggregate counter, off by default and toggled from the Statistics page. Nothing else on the Statistics page ever leaves your installation.
- Generation now streams real progress stages instead of a static "Generating…" message, and AI prompts are date-aware, fixing cases where the model treated the current or a past year as "the future."
- Tightened catalogue matching: fewer false-positive tribute/cover matches, trailing "feat." credits no longer break title matching, and MusicBrainz lookups skip redundant edition/version-suffix noise.

## Statistics, diagnostics and settings

- New Statistics page showing total playlists generated, saved and published, a month-by-month activity chart, and top-5 lists for artists, genres, moods and periods — each with a "See all" link to the complete ranked list.
- New Nerd stats page (linked from the bottom of Statistics) with AI provider usage, average/median/P95 generation time and a breakdown of recent generation errors.
- Diagnostics (bug report download, GitHub bug-report link, build info) moved out of Settings into its own page, reachable directly from the sidebar.
- Settings is now a standalone page like Statistics and Diagnostics, reached by navigating to it rather than opening in an overlay.
- Reorganized the sidebar into clearer groups (Integrations, Support, Insights).
- Added an opt-in "contribute to the public playlists-generated counter" toggle on the Statistics page — disabled by default, with a plain-language explanation of exactly what it sends (a single anonymous ping, no installation ID, no prompt or playlist content).

## Generation quality and catalogue matching

- AI prompts now carry the real current date and are told explicitly not to call the current or a past year "the future," fixing a confusing ambiguity warning and playlist-coherence issues it could mask.
- Generation progress is streamed to the UI stage-by-stage instead of showing a single static message for the whole request.
- Recalibrated the "Request complexity" indicator so it tracks actual generation cost rather than just how semantically complex the prompt reads.
- Widened cover/tribute-band detection to catch phrasings like "in the style of," reducing false-positive matches against tribute recordings.
- Title matching now ignores trailing "feat."/"ft."/"featuring" collaborator credits, so real matches with a different guest artist listed aren't rejected.
- MusicBrainz release-year lookups strip edition/version suffixes (e.g. "(Classic Version)") before matching and skip a redundant second lookup once a release is already confidently identified.
- Added semantic creative-fit and national/regional-origin checks so a request tied to a specific mood, vibe, country or region is enforced more consistently, not just pattern-matched.
- Reconnected a lightweight, time-bounded ReccoBeats catalogue-grounding step for the first draft of a generation, after an earlier, slower multi-stage version was found to add too much latency for the benefit.
- Stabilized AI model selection: fixed a settings bug where a saved custom model could silently revert after reload, model discovery now excludes preview/experimental variants by default, and provider calls use a rate-limit-aware fallback cascade across configured models.
- Generated playlist descriptions now include a discreet "Made with PlaylistMuse" signature with a link back to the project, kept within YouTube's 5000-character description limit even on long descriptions.

## Reliability and performance

- Batched MusicBrainz validation calls to cut redundant lookups during generation.
- Added a cached, rate-limit-safe check against GitHub for newer stable or dev-branch releases, surfaced as an update indicator in the sidebar footer.

## Interface improvements

- Fixed the sidebar Last.fm status card not showing its hover state once configured.
- "Surprise me" prompt suggestions no longer repeat the same music family (e.g. "rock") within a handful of clicks — recent picks are now excluded from the next suggestion.

## Upgrade notes

- The public playlists-generated counter is fully opt-in and off by default; nothing changes for existing installations unless you turn it on from the Statistics page. Self-hosters who want to run their own aggregator instead of the shared one can point `PLAYLISTMUSE_TELEMETRY_URL` at their own deployment (see `stats-service/README.md`).
